limitations: No live Render deployment and no Store-built Docker acceptance run in this checkout; both are owner-gated.
evidence_verifier and portfolio_rollup are vendored echo blocks: the platform feeds them real records and persists the answer; the upstream logic is not reimplemented here.
Marketplace/e-commerce connectors are not built: omnichannel publishes and records sync events on the in-process bus, it does not call a marketplace API (offline by contract).
sbom.cdx.json is not emitted on this writer path; dependency pins live in requirements.txt.
